about.title: About Nirmanee
about.lead: Nirmanee Digital Print House is a print studio in Kalutara, Sri Lanka. We print photos, gifts, signage and business stationery — and we treat every order as a job, not just a sale.
about.how1: A designer looks at every order before anything is printed.
about.how2: You see a proof in your job chat and approve it — or ask for changes. Two revisions are free.
about.how3: We print in-house, check quality by hand and pack carefully for pickup or courier.
about.whatText: Photo mugs and sublimation gifts, photo framing, crystal printing, laser cutting and wood engraving, banners and large format, plan printing, T-shirts, edible cake prints and custom souvenirs.
about.visitText: Drop by our Kalutara shop to see samples, talk to a designer or collect your order.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.lead: The fastest way to reach us is WhatsApp — send photos, questions or your idea and we'll reply during opening hours.
contact.deliveryText: Pickup at our Kalutara shop is free. Courier delivery is available islandwide with flat fees for Kalutara district, Western Province and the rest of the island.
